body:
I'm also concerned about having so many different ways to do the same thing. We need a more common method for letting user have a bit more freedom on the markup generated.

For the tests I have to do today, I only need the id, but I'm pretty sure I will need a lot more html attributes in the future and we cannot handle every specific need in our widgets. Users might need to add other custom classes, acceskey shortcuts, aria attributes for screen readers and a lot more things.

`htmlAttributes` might not be the right choice, though. It is a Javascript object, and some keys (like `class` and `for`) will have to be renamed (as `cssClass` and `htmlFor`) before being actually passed to React.
